{{Sexagenary cycle}}

'''Yang Water Rat''' (壬子, ''mizunoe nezumi''; onyomi ''jinshi'') is the 49th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 49th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yin Metal Pig|ja|辛亥}} and followed by {{ill|Yin Water Ox|ja|癸丑}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem}} ''壬'' is Yang Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch}} ''子'' (Rat) is Yang Water; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing}}.
==Pronunciation==
* English: Yang Water Rat (壬子)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): rénzǐ
** Cantonese (Jyutping): jam4 zi2
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoe-nezumi
*** On'yomi: jinshi
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): imja (임자)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Nhâm Tý

==Months of Yang Water Rat==
Because the water element is duplicated, a superstition arose that while many fires occur in {{ill|Yang Fire Horse|ja|丙午|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Besshi|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} years, many water disasters ({{ill|water-related disaster|ja|水害|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Water disaster|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11252966}}) occur in {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子|2=ja|3=壬子|4=zh|5=壬子|6=ko|7=임자|lt_ko=임자|8=fr|9=Rat de eau|10=de|11=Wasser-Ratte|12=en|13=User:Immanuelle/Yang Water Rat}} years. In the late Edo period, {{ill|Takizawa Bakin|en|Takizawa Bakin|qid=Q463142|lt=Kyokutei Bakin}} remarked, "If it is so with a Besshi year, then in a Jinshi year the double presence of water elements will surely bring about a great flood."

However, the superstition that "men born in a Jinshi year have weak constitutions" did not spread; for instance, in {{ill|1972|en|1972|qid=Q2476|lt=1972 AD}} (Shōwa 47), nearly 2 million births occurred during a Jinshi year as part of the second {{ill|Baby boom|en|Baby boom|qid=Q610548|lt=Baby Boom}}, and there are no recorded instances from {{ill|1852|en|1852|qid=Q7661|lt=1852 AD}} (Kaei 5) or {{ill|1912|en|1912|qid=Q2077|lt=1912 AD}} (Meiji 45/Taishō 1) of men being unable to marry due to being born in a Jinshi year.

==Days of Yang Water Rat==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 2 or 7 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Mizunoe (壬)|ja|壬|lt=Mizunoe (壬)|2=ja|3=壬|4=zh|5=壬|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ren}} or {{ill|Hinoto (丁)|ja|丁|lt=Hinoto (丁)|2=ja|3=丁|4=zh|5=丁|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tei}}), the month of {{ill|November|en|November|qid=Q125|lt=November}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=Month}} of {{ill|Yang Water Rat|ja|壬子|2=ja|3=壬子|4=zh|5=壬子|6=ko|7=임자|lt_ko=임자|8=fr|9=Rat de eau|10=de|11=Wasser-Ratte|12=en|13=User:Immanuelle/Yang Water Rat}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow}} until the day before {{ill|Xiaohan|en|Xiaohan|qid=Q1190989|lt=Lesser Cold}}) as applicable.

==Yang Water Rat (壬子)'s Days==
==={{nihongo|selection days|選日|senjitsu}}===
